description: This file defines a Flutter widget called WalletHistoryCard, which displays a transaction history entry for wallet activities such as purchases or returns. It includes UI components like icons, text labels, and a list of product cards associated with each transaction.

classes.name: WalletHistoryCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a wallet transaction history entry, including details such as date, amount, type (return or purchase), and associated products.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, constructing a container with transaction details and a list of related product cards.
